storage_and_startup_regressions: Complete local cache and a valid empty list become hydrated only after load completion.
Concurrent normal loads coalesce and publish the complete snapshot once.
Account reset invalidates the old generation and new account hydration remains available.
Initial load, forced reload and local writes share the storage queue.
A controlled prefs gate pauses a large corrupt-cache repair while cloud replaces storage; the old repair must not overwrite remote records, and a later local edit retains the remote records.
A force reload queued during initial hydration finishes with the cloud snapshot.
Repeated external snapshot replacement fails hydration and the dependent mutation; a later stable read and edit succeed without dropping the remote record.
Post-frame todo hydration remains unawaited, inside actual dirty-mark suppression; the timeout guard wraps that future. Public config starts immediately; other 14s/75s/12s staggering remains guarded.

review.instant_conversion_claim_checked_against: The claim that a local DateTime immediately shifts incorrectly was not supported by the production-format tests in both host zones; no storage migration or global formatter change was made.
review.initial_test_notification_failure: An initial new assertion counted the provider load-complete microtask. The final test takes its notification baseline after initial pump and asserts that zone changes add no notification. Earlier failure logs are retained in scratch.
review.spec_followup: Added bounded hydration failure/retry semantics to docs/cloud-sync-v2-contract.md and docs/design-v2.md. The five changed docs otherwise matched the implementation.
